title: 576. Longest Palindromic Subsequence

examples.explanation: Skipping one 'a' leaves "bbbb", a palindrome of length 4.
A single character is always a palindrome.

hints: Let dp[i][j] cover the substring s[i..j]; matching ends extend the inner answer by 2, mismatched ends take the better of the two shrunk intervals.
Fill the table by increasing substring length so inner results are ready, keeping only one row to save memory.
